died.name: Johann Georg Jacobi
died.cause: referring to a poem for New Year's Day that he had completed on New Year's Eve; he in fact lived 5 more days
died.last_words: I shall not in fact see the new year which I have just commemorated.

died.name: Elizabeth Ann Seton
died.desc: SC, American Catholic religious sister and educator
died.last_words: Soul of Christ, sanctify me; Body of Christ, save me; Blood of Christ, inebriate me; Water out of the side of Christ, strengthen me. Jesus, Mary, Joseph.

died.name: Alfred von Schlieffen
died.last_words: Remember, keep the right wing strong.

died.name: T. S. Eliot
died.cause: whispering the name of his wife, Valerie Eliot

died.name: Donald Campbell
died.cause: just before fatal crash of Bluebird K7 hydroplane while trying to set new world water speed record
died.last_words: The water's dark green and I can't see a bloody thing. Hallo the bow is up. I'm going. I'm on my back. I'm gone.

born.name: Filippo Strozzi the Younger
born.cause: He carved this line from Virgil's Aeneid on a mantelpiece with his sword as his suicide note
born.last_words: May an avenger arise from my bones.

born.name: James Ussher
born.desc: Church of Ireland Archbishop of Armagh and Primate of All Ireland
born.last_words: O Lord, forgive me specially my sins of omission.

born.name: Benjamin Rush
born.desc: American physician, signer of the United States Declaration of Independence
born.last_words: I will not abandon the post which Providence has assigned me; I think it my duty not only to sacrifice my pleasure and repose, but my life, should it be necessary, for the safety of my patients.
